Hixshixxis, King of the Naga, kept closely to routine. He slithered the same path through his garden every morning.

So it was a great surprise when something jabbed between two of his scales. He looked down, and saw a shard of [cystal](http://orig07.deviantart.net/dd12/f/2011/354/3/7/crystal_lamp_by_aexion-d4jpdr5.png) jabbing into him from between two of the stones he had smoothed down through years of slithering. Bending over, he reached down to pick it up. As soon as his fingers touched the crystal, something *changed*.

Everything slowed down, lifting the crystal from between the stones seemed to take minutes rather than seconds. A pounding sounded in his ears, and a crawling sensation seemed to fill his scalp. Looking down at his hands, he could *see* the movement of his blood through the veins in the back of it. Flexing his grip, he was aware of the movement of every muscle, every tendon. And also a change in the crawling that filled his brain.

As soon as he noticed, the crawling shifted again. And in response to his noticing that, it shifted again. The king was wise enough to realize he was sensing his own thoughts. He focused his attention on them and slithered forward a little. He watched individual thoughts leaving his brain and sliding through his spine, all the way to his tail where they commanded its motion.

King Hixshixxis returned his attention to his brain. Focusing on a few thoughts seemed to make them more prominent. Each thought seemed distinct, and he was sure he could learn to identify them. Cautiously, he ordered a thought to attach to another one. Instantly, he felt the effects. He now believed that the Lot'dy lived on land. He undid that change quickly, and wondered at his new power over himself. This would definitely bear further experimentation. He should return to his palace at one and study this crystal more, he had been out far too long and was likely missed anyways. He placed the crystal in a pocket of his robes and turned back.

Returning to the palace, his mate, Sheerxixxish, looked up from her reading. "You're back early." She commented.

"What do you mean, I've been gone hours!" replid Hixshixxis, confused.

"It's been 20 minutes." The Queen insisted. "I know you lose track of time on your walks, but usually it's in the other direction."

"Ah!" Realization came quickly to the king of the Naga. "It's this crystal I found. here, take it."

He reached into his robes for the crystal, and as soon as his fingers brushed the crystal, everything slowed down again. It took a maddeningly long time to cross the distance to his mate, even as she turned and approached him. He saw her bump an intricate coral vase with her elbow, saw it begin to fall. He had time to reach out and catch it with his free hand, see her begin to gasp, and place the crystal in her hand.

*****

Speaking was difficult when holding the crystal, but it seemed to have no ill effects. Soon, all the greatest Naga scholars were working to catelogue the King's discovery.
